verdict.rationale: Apify documents official SDKs and API clients for both JavaScript and Python. The docs cover running Actors and retrieving results, error subclasses, default retries, async log streaming, pagination and a changelog, plus a separate Apify SDK for JS with session and proxy management. Community comments only mention looking forward to a new SDK. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Learn how to authenticate, run Actors, and retrieve results using the Apify API client for Python.
The Apify client provides dedicated error subclasses based on the HTTP status code of the failed response, so you can branch on error kind
By default, the client retries a failed request up to 4 times.
SessionPool is a class that allows you to handle the rotation of proxy IP addresses along with cookies and other custom settings in Apify SDK.
Software toolkits for developing new Actors.
